generated_by: curated; each suggestion lists the evidence that would justify it and the exact file it touches

scoring.impact: 1 (cosmetic) .. 5 (changes whether a decision can be made)
scoring.priority_formula: round(impact * confidence / (effort * risk), 2) - higher is better
scoring.decision_rule: Implement in rank order. A suggestion with confidence <= 2 needs a pilot before it touches a published number.

suggestions.title: Publish the empty leaderboard, with the losing results, instead of hiding it
suggestions.problem: A reader cannot tell whether 'no qualifiers' means 'not tested' or 'tested and failed'.
suggestions.proposal: Show all 8 candidates, every gate, and the negative holdout ROI on the same page as the leaderboard. Only this repository does this today.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Turns the weakest page into the strongest trust signal; makes future winners interpretable.

suggestions.title: Write the reward policy before the first qualifier exists
suggestions.problem: Rewards are defined in code (Tier A/B/C) but no one has decided what a Tier A pass authorises.
suggestions.proposal: One page: what a qualifier may claim, who reviews it, expiry, and how it can be revoked if the holdout degrades.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Prevents the incentive to loosen gates under pressure; makes rewards auditable.

suggestions.title: Test dependence before pricing any combo, and publish the multiplier ratio
suggestions.problem: Combo pricing silently assumes independence; this repo now measures it, but only for one pair type.
suggestions.proposal: Show observed joint / independent joint next to every combo price. Extend to player props once data exists.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Stops the most common false edge in same-game parlays.
suggestions.evidence: C1 ratio 1.023 with phi CI spanning 0; data/nfl/model/correlations.json

suggestions.title: Publish the model's own uncertainty before its line
suggestions.problem: A single number ('NYG -2.5') hides a +/- 6 point parameter error.
suggestions.proposal: Lead with the interval (e.g. WAS +8 to -13 relative to a 2.5 line) and the probability at the line, then the line.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Stops over-reading small edges; matches gate G06's logic.
suggestions.evidence: week10.json model_margin_se 5.98 on the Thursday game

suggestions.title: Replace 'luck removed' language with 'luck reduced, stated how'
suggestions.problem: No finite sample removes luck; a page that says so loses credibility with anyone who knows statistics.
suggestions.proposal: State the mechanism (clustered intervals, multiplicity control, deflated Sharpe, lower-bound ranking) and the residual risk (a passing strategy can still lose).
suggestions.expected_benefit: Accurate claim that survives expert review.

suggestions.title: Freeze the Week 10 own lines now and grade them after Week 10
suggestions.problem: A model line published after the games is unfalsifiable.
suggestions.proposal: Each week, commit the own-line file before kickoff (hash + timestamp), then auto-grade spread/total/ML after the official results appear. Ten weeks of that is 140 graded lines, enough to test calibration.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Converts the model from 'a method' into a track record with a public timestamp.
suggestions.evidence: https://github.com/sassnarep3-star/Own6/blob/main/data/nfl/model/week10.json published 2026-11-12, before the first kickoff (20:15 ET)

suggestions.title: Ship the repository-check page as a permanent defect ledger
suggestions.problem: Defects found in one session vanish from view in the next.
suggestions.proposal: A table of every defect found (D-01..), with status, repro command, and the commit that fixed it.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Prevents regressions and gives a reviewer a checklist.
suggestions.evidence: D-01 (main CI red on clean checkout), D-02 (community file missing AZ rows), D-03 (assumed -110 price)

suggestions.title: Do not add a live odds widget until a licence exists
suggestions.problem: The obvious 'improvement' is the one that creates the legal exposure.
suggestions.proposal: Record the decision explicitly so a future session does not re-litigate it.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Protects the project; saves a wasted build.
suggestions.evidence: NFL.com Terms section 1.3 (non-commercial, no systematic retrieval) quoted on the Sources page

suggestions.title: Store every injury report edition, not just the latest
suggestions.problem: NFL.com serves only the current week; the history that makes practice status predictive is lost each week.
suggestions.proposal: Daily capture of the injury page with a timestamp; the page shows week-by-week history, so archives can be back-filled.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Enables Q11 (practice status -> game status) and a real injury-value regression (Q10).

suggestions.title: Add a 'what would change my mind' line to every published number
suggestions.problem: Numbers without falsification conditions are decoration.
suggestions.proposal: Each table row gets a short column: the observation that would overturn it. The questions register already carries this for 18 items.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Makes review cheap: a reader knows what to check first.

suggestions.title: Split singles, parlays and prop combos into three leaderboards
suggestions.problem: One table ranks 1-leg bets against 4-leg parlays; variance differs by an order of magnitude.
suggestions.proposal: Three boards with the same gates but separate reward tiers, because a parlay needs far more bets to clear the same lower bound.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Comparable entries; no parlay wins by variance alone.
suggestions.evidence: S1/S2/S3 (singles) vs S6/S7 (blocked parlay candidates) in backtest.json

suggestions.title: Monthly re-read of the official pages that every number depends on
suggestions.problem: Standings, injuries and rules change; a snapshot silently rots.
suggestions.proposal: A dated re-read that diffs against the stored raw CSVs and flags any drift, the way the NBA pack already does.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The site can never publish a stale claim without saying so.

suggestions.title: Keep the two site sections (framework vs lab) but give them one nav entry
suggestions.problem: Two NFL sections exist after PR #66 merged; readers cannot tell which is current.
suggestions.proposal: One nav link 'NFL' that lands on a short chooser page: Framework (PR #66) and Lab (this pack), with what each proves.
suggestions.expected_benefit: No duplicated effort visible to the reader; no file conflicts between sessions.

suggestions.title: Capture all 32 official club depth charts daily, not three
suggestions.problem: The availability model can only answer for WAS, NYG and DET because only those three charts were read.
suggestions.proposal: A scheduled capture of each club's /team/depth-chart page, stored with a timestamp and hash. Each club publishes one; the URLs follow the club domain pattern.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Makes 2nd/3rd/4th-string deficiency a league-wide, auditable table instead of a sample.

suggestions.title: Buy or borrow a licensed closing-line feed with book + timestamp
suggestions.problem: Every market comparison currently uses a community number with no book, no time, and an assumed -110 price.
suggestions.proposal: One book/aggregator contract that names the book and stamps each price. Gate G02 and G07 cannot pass without it.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Unblocks CLV, de-vigged fair prices, and every ROI statement that currently carries an assumption.
suggestions.evidence: https://github.com/sassnarep3-star/Own6/blob/main/data/nfl/model/backtest.json configuration.bet_price_assumption; gate G07 blocked on all candidates

decision_matrix_note: Rank by priority_formula, but never let a low-risk item jump a blocking one: SG-03 (licence) gates SG-01/SG-02 payouts.
